title: Ing sinuku nang kaladwa ning sagradung api
intro: Bayu mu ing metung a kwentu ning pambihirang katapangan, nung nukarin ing metung a indibidwal mengangas yang labanan ing peka-matatag a kapaniwalan ning mabilug a sibilisasyun. Tukian mo reng bulong a reni ibat keng milabas, at akit me ing bie a makamarka keng alang patugut a kasalpantayanan, milagrosung kaligtasan, ampo ing pamaglalang pundasyun na magshape keng espiritual a pamaglakbe da reng bilyun-bilyun. Tukian meng masalese ing balang clue — ing sagradung api atatandanan na pa.
clues: mibait ku keng metung a pamilya na gagalangan da la ring bage banua ampo ding idolo, pero atin kung bage a e na buri ing sasamban da.

Tinalakad ku laban king pekamasikan a pamuntuk ning kanakung bansa, lesak ku la ding mismung idolo a pisamban da ring kanakung memalen, at pepasiag ku king ing Miglalang king banua mu ing karapatdapat king debosyon.
Metung a masilab a pyre ing inutus na keng lagyu ku, pero sinabi ku na ing metung a susuyuan ku yamu ing magligtas kanaku — at ding lablab inutus da na maging marimla at ligtas.
likuan ku ing sablang pamilyar ku keng metung a utus ning banal, maglakbe ku kareng malanging libis kayabe ing pamilya ku, magtiwala ku keng probisyon na eku pa akit.
makatalakad keng siping ning anak kung pangane keng metung a libis a alang tanaman, telakad mi la reng pundasyun ning metung a sagradung bale, metung a santuaryu para kareng sablang magpasakup.
Kilala ku bilang Khalilullah — ing matalik a kakaluguran ning Peka-Mapaglunus — at ing lagyu ku meging yang alang anggang makasuglung king kasalpantayanan ning pamagsuku at pamagpasakup.

options: Miyugse ya keng milalablab a api ning metung a tiranu
Melaso ya keng kilub ning maragul a asan keng dagat

location.label: Key Element
options: Ing sagradung bale (kaaba)
Metung a maragul a lulanan a gawa keng dutung a mitalakad babo ning bunduk
metung a tukud na malyaring magbukas keng dagat
Metung a kueba ning makabang pangatudtud a maki tapat a asu

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Mekilala ya bilang Khalilullah, ing matalik a kakaluguran nang Allah
Tinimuna no reng tau king metung a dayatmalat a mikawani papunta king kaligtasan
mirinan yang pamag-ari kareng angin ampo kareng e mayayakit a pwersa
Meging metung yang manulu a mibendisyunan kareng makapagmulalang pamanulu
Misanmetung la ding labing aduang tribu a makakalat lalam ning metung a kasunduan
outcome.answer: Mekilala ya bilang Khalilullah, ing matalik a kakaluguran nang Allah

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
